static_traits.name: 梁淑芳
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因频繁寻求对编织的认可而紧张；有几位密友但not yet与其讨论自卑感受
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似的自卑感；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, with fairly good logic; attitude negative, with strong self-criticism; willing to try but holds a skeptical attitude; tends to seek others' approval; feels embarrassed about discussing personal problems with others and avoids it

basic_info.main_problem: 因为在一次编织比赛中not yet获得第一名，持续感到自己是“糟糕的编织者”，引发显著的自卑与自我批评，影响工作专注、Interpersonal relationships与日常自我照顾。
basic_info.core_demands: “我只想感觉自己是有能力的而not是一个彻底的失败者。我想重新享受编织，not让这些负面想法压过一切。”；“这类not足感影响了我的自尊与整体幸福感，因此寻求咨询。”

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（在编织方面）
我的价值取决于是否赢得第一名

special_situations.event: 编织比赛结果公布，not yet获得第一名
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not拿到第一名，就说明我的编织很糟、I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 给自己施加很大压力去表现、加倍练习提高技巧
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我真是个糟糕的编织者/我失败了

special_situations.event: 每次拿起编织针或想到这次比赛
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次编织，就会再次失败，证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度自我批评、避免与密友讨论以防尴尬
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次也会很糟糕，我会再次失败

special_situations.event: 与同事互动时频繁寻求对编织的认可，关系因此紧张
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的评价决定我的能力与价值；如果他们not认可，我就not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向同事寻求外部认可、回避独立评估
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我的编织not够好/看not起我

special_situations.event: 在not yet获第一名后回想投入的时间与精力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果努力have not换来第一名，所有付出都not算数
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的努力都白费了，什么都not算

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为有能力并Gaining recognition（尤其在编织方面）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，导致自我价值崩塌与羞耻
defense_goal: 以高标准与Self-monitoring来避免失败
通过寻求外部认可来缓解not安
避免与朋友讨论以防尴尬和羞耻

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、评判性的他者（同事/评委）
会轻视自己问题、认为琐碎的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to explore and restructure the rigid belief of 'must win', or to set more realistic goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些负面想法“很真实、很难改变”，对改变持怀疑态度
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和而稳定的语气，承认其感受的真实，同时将体验与事实区分；use具体例证引导其进行小步实验，避免对抗式说服。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问是否与密友分享这些not足与羞耻感受时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为编织问题“太琐碎，not值得谈”，从而回避分享
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopt a normalizing and de-stigmatizing tone, emphasize the impact of the problem on their well-being; use open-ended questions to invite recollections of the support that might be gained after sharing, and encourage attempting a limited degree of self-disclosure.

manifestations: not yet获第一名后感到“投入都白费”
将编织与他人更严重问题比较，认为自己的困扰“很琐碎”
自我价值过度依赖外界评判（比赛结果、同事认可）
以“必须赢得第一名”这类僵化规则自我束缚
高期望与高压力下失去选择的弹性

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须赢得第一名才算好”的规则评判自己
将比赛结果当作能力与价值的唯一标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: not敢与密友讨论，过度谨慎地管理自我暴露

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 以“编织问题很琐碎”为由回避与他人谈论真实感受
在谈到失败情绪时转向解释比赛环境/评委口味

positive_force: 对编织投入时间与精力，具备学习与改进的动机
能够清晰表达自身想法与感受
愿意尝试以小步目标进行改变
有几位密友可潜在提供支持
negative_force: 非黑即白的自我评价与完美主义规则
强烈自我批评导致Impaired self-esteem与回避分享

target_behavior.behavior: 持续的自我批评与失败感（围绕编织表现）
antecedent: 想到编织比赛及其结果
与同事互动、寻求对编织的认可时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将比赛结果与自我价值等同，形成非黑即白与灾难化的认知，进而引发Self-denial与羞耻
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与羞耻感、寻求外部认可以短暂缓解not安
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus、同事Relationship tension、Daily self-care affected，自尊进一步受损
